description: This file defines a BufferWindowMemory node class for managing memory in a chat application, including initialization and message retrieval methods, and references external memory and database modules.

classes.name: BufferWindowMemory_Memory
classes.description: Implements a memory node that manages a window of chat messages for a chat application.

classes.name: BufferWindowMemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends FlowiseWindowMemory to provide chat message retrieval and management with database integration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the BufferWindowMemoryExtended instance with parameters from nodeData and options.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from the database, optionally returning base message objects or formatted IMessage objects.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, managed at server level.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, managed at server level.
